common_law.adaptive_bound: if lower_i <= r_i(history) <= upper_i along miss histories, product(1-upper_i) <= P(miss) <= product(1-lower_i)
common_law.adaptive_chain_rule: P(no E_1,...,no E_N) = product_i (1-r_i), where r_i=P(E_i | previous misses)
common_law.distribution_shift_role: the gate hazard is measured under its rollout law; planner reach and conditional shipped cost determine consequence, not the miss exponent
common_law.failure_limit: marginal hazards P(E_i) alone do not identify miss probability under dependence/adaptation
common_law.independent_train_gate_corollary: same r and independent blocks give (1-r)^(N_train+N_gate)
common_law.two_mode_corollary: Frechet union bounds followed by the same iid exponent
